sentences.en: This cartographer is famous for the precision in his maps.
sentences.zh: 这位制图师以地图的精准而闻名。

sentences.en: This cartographer is famous for the precision in her maps.
sentences.zh: 这位女制图师以地图的精准而闻名。

sentences.en: Live your life with the precision of a Samurai.
sentences.zh: 像武士一样精确地生活。

senses.zh: 精确（性），准确（性）；严谨，细致；（测量、计算或说明的）精确化（尤以数字表现）
（设计）精密的，精确的；要求技术精确的，（行动）精确的
